voiceSummary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in newspapers on November 7, 2026. Nido Home Finance Limited issued a branch continuation notice stating that the proposed relocation of its Delhi and Kolkata branches will not proceed. The Delhi branch continues at First Floor, 38, Rajendra Park, Pusa Road, New Delhi, and the Kolkata branch continues at 44 Park Street, 9th Floor, Saket Building, Kolkata. Patback Business Limited reported standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 6, 2026. Reliance Industries Limited issued a notice regarding lost or misapplied share certificates, inviting claims within seven days. NeoGrowth Credit Private Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 5, 2026. Prima Plastics Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 6, 2026. Ajax Engineering Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026.
